PC Jeweller Shares Decline After Three-Day Rally

PC Jeweller shares fell by over 5% following a three-day period where they had gained 37%. This decline is attributed by one outlet to profit booking after the sharp rally. Despite the recent drop, the stock has seen significant long-term growth, with gains of 388% over three years and 424% over five years. One report noted the stock was up 31% in the past week and 45% in 2026.
